BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BARCH   SEMESTER: III/ADD
BRANCH: ARCH   SESSION : MO/2018

SUBJECT : AR3301-BUILDING SCIENCE-I (CLIMATOLOGY)

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) What are the six main factors impacting the climate of a place? List them. [2]
 (b) Explain the major global wind patterns prevalent, writing in brief about each. Also sketch
them.
[3]


Q2 (a) What are the three main ways of heat exchange between the human being inside a room
with a window and the surrounding environment? Explain with the help of a sketch.
[2]
 (b) Explain the main difference between simple bioclimatic chart (Olgyay, 1961) and Building
Bioclimatic Chart (Givony, 1969) explaining each with proper illustrations.
[3]


Q3 (a) Define sea-breeze. Explain in two lines with figure. [2]
 (b) Classify the various tropical climates. Mention the basic characteristics of each. [3]


Q4 (a) What is the difference between weather and climate? Explain. [2]
 (b) What factors contribute to the micro-climate of a particular place in a region being
different from the macro-climate of that region as a whole? Explain giving an example.
[3]


Q5 (a) Name and explain in one or two lines each the four (4) main external environmental
factors which affect the placement of building on site, orientation and building forms.
[2]
 (b) How do you select a site on a mountainous slope in: a. Cold and windy region, b. High-
Altitude region in otherwise warm-humid region near equator where it is not too cold
and warm in summer, and c. valley area where the wind movement is perpendicular to
the valley (in a cold area).
[3]


Q6      Write an elaborate note on climate-balanced architecture. [5]
